_about: Public-domain Benet of Canfield (William Fitch, 1562-1610), the English Capuchin mystic, for the Word Hoard: The Rule of Perfection, which he wrote in English (Rouen: John Cousturier, approbation 1608), and The Holy Will of God, a short rule of perfection, translated by Father Collins (1878), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 37 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

canfield-rule-perfection-1609: The Rule of Perfection, contayning a breif and perspicuous abridgement of all the wholle spirituall life (Rouen: for Iohn Cousturier; approbation dated 1608, catalogued 1609)
canfield-holy-will-1878: The Holy Will of God: a short rule of perfection, tr. Father Collins (London: Thomas Richardson & Sons, 1878)

_alternates.canfield-copies: Two other 1609 issues (title pages garbled); A Bright Starre (third part of the Rule, catalogued 1646, translator garbled); TheHolyWillOfGod (another copy)

_excluded.canfield-other: The Christian Knight (1619): the title page credits Sir William Wiseman
